title: Death Notifs
body:
# Beta 1.7.3 Death Notifications

## Overview
**Death Notifications Plugin** for **Minecraft Beta 1.7.3** tested **Bukkit-0.0.0-980-g4ed23b1-b1060jnks** implements custom messages whenever a player dies.

## Features

- **Per-Player Notifications**
  - Each player can receive tailored death messages.

- **Lightweight & Optimized**
  - Built specifically for **Beta 1.7.3**, ensuring compatibility and minimal performance impact.


## Configuration
- Configure custom messages in the plugin config file.
- Enable or disable per-player notifications as needed.

## Compatibility
- **Minecraft Version:** Beta 1.7.3 only
